propositions: git fetch hangs intermittently past 300s wall-clock timeout when connection is established but sends zero bytes, due to missing http.lowSpeedLimit and http.lowSpeedTime config
adding throughput-keyed abort via http.lowSpeedLimit=1000 B/s and http.lowSpeedTime=10s configuration causes stalled connections to abort in ~10 seconds with 'Operation too slow' error
in-process retry of low-speed abort failures (bounded attempts) enables transient stalls to self-heal within a single review cycle instead of deferring to backfill
genuinely slow-but-progressing transfers (e.g. legitimately slow 90-second full clone) are not aborted when throughput remains above the configured floor
git-subprocess and fetch-locking cluster extracted from repo_snapshot.py (788/800 LOC) into new sibling git_fetch.py module to stay under 800 LOC hard cap
